versions.content: Content of Communication Error Info The Communication Er- ror Info Rte_ComErrorInfo structure can contains the following: • TransportErrorCount generated if transportErrorCountEnabled is set to TRUE and it contains the number of transport errors (e.g. Com timeout moni- toring) since the last call of the respective RTE API. • ValueErrorCount generated if valueErrorCountEnabled is set to TRUE and it contains the number of value errors (e.g. out of range, invalid value) since the last call of the respective RTE API.
